decision.reason: The evidence clearly shows a rename. [ev-0739bc6582ad] lists `envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_update_success` -> `envoy_cilium_npds_update_success`, and [ev-77f05428497a] says the prefix of all Envoy NPDS metrics changed from `envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_` to `envoy_cilium_npds_`. The problem is the subject: it is a Prometheus metric name, and no subject family covers metrics. protocol-behavior is for wire and protocol behaviour such as TLS, ALPN or path matching, and its names must be lowercase kebab-case. The proposed name keeps the literal metric spelling, so it breaks that rule. Turning it into kebab-case would lose the exact metric identity, so I cannot accept or correct this without a taxonomy decision on how to represent metrics.
